verses.text: Listen to this message, you women of Samaria, you fat cows of Bashan on the hill of Samaria! You oppress the poor and crush the needy. You say to your husbands, "Bring us something to drink!"
The Lord GOD has sworn by his holiness: "The time will surely come when you will be taken away with hooks, every last one of you with fishhooks.
You will go straight out through the gaps in the city walls, each one of you, and you will be thrown out toward Harmon," says the LORD.
"Go to Bethel and sin! Go to Gilgal and sin even more! Bring your sacrifices every morning and your tenth of your crops every three days.
Burn bread made with yeast as a thank offering. Announce your voluntary offerings and brag about them. This is what you love to do, people of Israel," says the Lord GOD.
"I gave you empty stomachs in every city and a lack of food in every town, yet you did not return to me," says the LORD.
"I also held back the rain from you when the harvest was still three months away. I sent rain on one town but not on another. One field had rain, and another field without rain dried up.
People from two or three towns staggered to another town for water, but they could not get enough to drink. Yet you did not return to me," says the LORD.
"Many times I struck your gardens and vineyards with blight and mildew. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive trees. Yet you did not return to me," says the LORD.

"I sent plagues among you like the ones I sent on Egypt. I killed your young men with the sword and took away your horses. I filled your noses with the stench of your camps. Yet you did not return to me," says the LORD.
"I destroyed some of you, as I destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah. You were like a burning stick snatched out of the fire. Yet you did not return to me," says the LORD.
"So this is what I will do to you, Israel. And because I will do this to you, get ready to meet your God, Israel!"

He is the one who forms the mountains and creates the wind. He reveals his thoughts to people. He turns dawn into darkness and walks on the high places of the earth. The LORD God of Armies is his name.
